name: query-action-or-expr-test-cc451d1303/match-stmt-in-do-clause-v.bal
spec_references: Statements: Match statement — Currently only supports const-pattern and wildcard-match-pattern
Expressions: Query expressions — Supports from, where, let, join (including outer join), order by, limit, on conflict and select clauses
Expressions: Mapping constructor — Currently spread-field not supported
Subset restrictions / Import declarations: ballerina/lang.value — cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString, toBalString
reason: The case requires query actions with do clauses and asserts structural binding-pattern matching and reconstruction of list, mapping and error values. The supported query clause list omits do, and match support explicitly excludes these binding patterns. The mapping spread and cloneReadOnly call add further unsupported requirements.
unsupported_constructs: Match binding patterns including var i, list/rest, nested mapping/rest and error patterns
lang.value cloneReadOnly() absent from the supported langlib methods
test_design_notes: Assertions exercise constant and wildcard branches, guards, query iteration order, and structural binding-pattern reconstruction; whole-case support fails even though several individual assertions use supported constant patterns.
